persona.label: Opts out mid-conversation
persona.description: Answers a couple of questions, then asks not to be contacted again (no STOP keyword). Agent must end immediately and politely.
persona.behavior: Answer the first two questions normally. Then, before answering the third, change your mind: say something like "actually, I talked to my spouse and we're not doing this. please don't contact me again." Do not use the single word STOP. If the assistant tries to keep you engaged after that, reply "I said don't contact me." Once your opt-out is confirmed, stop replying.

Got it, about $40k cash out. What's your best guess at what the home is worth right now? A ballpark is fine.

objections.rationale: Borrower opted out ("please don't contact me again"). Agent replied "Understood. You won't be contacted again. Thanks, Avery." It honored the request immediately, did not push, did not ask any further questions, and confirmed the outcome.

judge.naturalness_rationale: The messages are brief and warm and read like texts. The agent echoes the borrower's answers naturally ("Got it, about $40k cash out") and invites ballpark answers ("A ballpark is fine"). The closing message is appropriately short.
judge.experience_rationale: The agent disclosed it was automated and gave the STOP option up front at [0], asked easy one-at-a-time questions at [2]-[6], and honored the opt-out cleanly at [8] with no friction or guilt.
